mentions.name: AI-free programming video series
mentions.description: This video series features the creator programming personal projects without AI assistance, narrating by typing into a box rather than speaking, with the aim of preserving traditional, AI-free programming practices. It is inspired by streamers like Tsoding.
mentions.source_excerpt: Pivoting into content creation. It's gonna be a series of videos of me programming, without AI assistance, so that some echo of the old ways persists, or at least is a little bit louder, for my having been here to preserve it. Mainly it will be work on personal projects I hold dear.
